d:
Experience the soulful vibes of “Anjaana Anjaani - video song” from The Paradise, featuring Nani and Kayadu Lohar. With music by Anirudh Ravichander and direction by Srikanth Odela, the song brings together powerful vocals, emotional lyrics, and an evocative musical atmosphere.
Song Credits:
Song name : Anjaana Anjaani
Singers : Anirudh Ravichander, Sublashini
Lyrcist : Kittu Vissapragada
Composed, Arranged & Produced by Anirudh Ravichander
Keyboards, Synth & Rhythm Programmed by Anirudh Ravichander
Additional Music Programed by Nivin Raphael
